table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname=  Case When issuedetail.itemdescription IS Null OR RTrim(LTrim(issuedetail.itemdescription)) = '' THEN item.name Else issuedetail.itemdescription END, 
			department=(select dbo.department.name from dbo.department where dbo.department.deptcode=dbo.issueheader.deptcode),
			itemalias=item.customicode,
			salesman = dbo.users.username,  
			issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 
			smanname=salesman.name,
         date = dbo.issueheader.date,
			price = Case ( Select DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('IssuePriceInPrint') ) When 1 THEN issuedetail.saleprice When 2 THEN issuedetail.purchaseprice WHEN 3 THEN issuedetail.avgprice WHEN 4 THEN issuedetail.MRPP WHEN 5 THEN issuedetail.price END,
			dbo.issueheader.deptcode,
 			dbo.issueheader.remarks,	
         gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
         icode = issuedetail.icode,   
         batch = issuedetail.batch,   
         expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
			looseqty = issuedetail.qty,
         referenceno=ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), '') + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + dbo.issueheader.referenceno,
         dbo.issueheader.referencedate,
			packing=(select itempacking.name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),
			Godown=(select Godown.name from Godown where Godown.gcode=issuedetail.gcode),
			itempacking = item.packingdesc,
			Id       = dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL,
			customer=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=issueheader.acccode),
			customeradd1=(select address1 from customer where customer.custcode=issueheader.acccode),
			customeradd2=(select address2 from customer where customer.custcode=issueheader.acccode),
			customerphone =(select phone from customer where customer.custcode=issueheader.acccode),
			custtaxregno =(select salestaxregno from customer where customer.custcode=issueheader.acccode),
			class=(select name from itemclass where itemclass.iccode=Item.iccode),
			category=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=item.icatcode)

    FROM issueheader, 
			issuedetail, 
			users, 
			item ,
			salesman
 
   WHERE ( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueInvCode ) AND
			( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND
			( dbo.issueheader.Smancode = dbo.SalesMan.Salesmancode ) AND 
			( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
			( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

ORDER BY dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL
